The '''''Imperator''''' was an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was assigned to [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]], located at one of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]]. It was later overrun by the native [[Yevetha]], who acquired all of the Command's assets, and was renamed '''''Splendor of Yevetha''''' by them. The vessel would later be used against the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|forces]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
Captured from Imperial forces of the Black Sword Command after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] by the alien [[Yevetha]], this ship subsequently entered the fleet of the Yevethan [[Duskhan League]], and was used in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] to capture the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[fleet shuttle]] ''[[Tampion]]'', and to kidnap [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

Renamed ''Splendor of Yevetha'', the ''Imperator'' was present at the New Republic's showdown with Nil Spaar's forces at N'zoth. With the rest of the Imperial-designed ships in Duskhan League service, she was recaptured by surviving Black Sword personnel under the leadership of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sil Sorannan]] during the [[Battle of N'zoth]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], and redirected to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Imperator/Splendor of Yevetha'' was described as an Interdictor Dreadnaught in ''[[Shield of Lies]]''. It was later clearly identified as an Immobilizer 418 in its entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
